title: What a Pill
text: What a Pill. Love Pinzon flannel and bought three sets for the whole house. They have lasted beautifully through 3 winters. These are beautiful out of package, strong and soft, fit is consistent across 3 pairs....but so is the pilling on flat sheet. Light blue pilled after second wash, noticeably in middle of sheet. Bummed and surprised. I count in Pinzon to be hassle free.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Pinzon 400 Thread Count Egyptian Cotton Sateen Hemstitch Sheet Set - Queen, Dusty Blue
features: Queen set includes flat sheet, fitted sheet, and 2 standard-size pillowcases
Egyptian cotton fibers are long and soft, which produces a durable and smooth fabric that will last for years with appropriate care
Lustrous, understated sheen; 6-inch hem with detailing on flat sheet and pillowcases
Recommend washing before first use; Machine wash in cold and tumble dry on low
Fitted sheet measures 60 x 80 inches and fits up to 14-inch-deep mattresses; flat sheet measures 100 x 112 inches, and pillowcases measure 20 x 31 inches
Made in OEKO-TEX Standard 100 factory, an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards.
